evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: Because no openly available professional environments pair realistic queries with resource-access patterns, we construct and release three controlled testbeds derived from existing datasets: NFCorpus, FEVER and Tech Startup.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: To act effectively, agents must gather contextual information across resources such as chats, issue trackers, email and knowledge bases, to answer questions like "what was decided in the last project meeting?" or "where is the FAQ for our internal tooling?" Where this information lives in a user's environment is unknown to the agent, so it re-explores the same resources across consecutive interactions.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Compared with supervised, tool-retrieval and contextual bandit baselines under a shared closed-loop protocol, Wayfinder gives the best routing when resources contain semantically overlapping content that static descriptions cannot distinguish, while description-based tool retrieval suffices when resources are drawn from distinct corpora.

declaredVenue: 20 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
